status_scope: INTERNAL production readiness ONLY. COMPLETE means every internally executable obligation is discharged and the repository-owned verification is green on candidate_sha. It is NOT a statement that production readiness is achieved: 12 tasks remain BLOCKED_EXTERNAL, the five external gates (A06, APPROVED_CONTENT, NATIVE_MODELS, HARDWARE, SIGNING) are OPEN, and verified_fixed is 0 because only an independent audit may set it.

second_green.scope: the docs-only tip of `main` (fast-forwarded onto candidate_sha)
second_green.note: Cited POSITIONALLY (newest push run on the `main` ref), not by literal id: the tip advances with each docs commit, so a literal run id or SHA here would self-invalidate.

repository_verification.run_pointer_note: CITED POSITIONALLY FOR THE TIP. This entry binds the run that exercised the FROZEN CANDIDATE (attempt 1 of 35446805693, all six jobs). GitHub reports the LATEST attempt, so that run's aggregate conclusion now reads 'failure' from attempt 2's transient Robolectric network error -- which is why the binding names ATTEMPT 1 and why `second_green` exists. For the main TIP, read the newest `push` run of `repository-verification` on the `main` ref; a literal run id here would go stale with each docs commit.

main_pointer_note: POSITIONAL, NOT LITERAL. `main_sha` is the frozen candidate that `main` was fast-forwarded to, and it equals the tag target. The docs record lives in a chain of docs-only commits ON TOP of it, so `main`'s TIP advances with each docs commit and is deliberately not written here: a literal tip SHA self-invalidates on the very next commit. For the tip, read the `main` ref; for the verified artifact, read the tag `production-readiness-board1-rc2`.

catalogue_path_gap.what_it_is: A task card's `required_regression_paths` is a repo-relative path, and 12 of them do not resolve. THE 12 SPLIT INTO TWO CLASSES WITH OPPOSITE REMEDIES, and fusing them was my error.

class_1_court_never_authored__SEVEN_OPEN.fact: The declared pure-python court was never authored: `git log --diff-filter=D` across all history shows it was never deleted because it never existed. Measured consequence: `python3 -m tools.readiness.run task T78 --stage narrow` -> 'FAILED exit=5 tests=0/0' -- the declared path can never satisfy the stage's own `assert_tests_positive`.
class_1_court_never_authored__SEVEN_OPEN.why_it_stays_OPEN: Backfilling these as fixtures would witness the SHAPE of the machinery instead of the task's real deliverable -- T79's negative is the independent auditor's pinned bytes, T80's the licensed human-reviewed corpus, T73-T75's a physical radio, T62-T65/T81's approved native binaries. Section 27 bars replacing a real dependency with a success stub, and test_blocked_external.py W03 forbids closing any gate with a fixture.
class_1_court_never_authored__SEVEN_OPEN.but_the_machinery_IS_witnessed: For T78 specifically, the refusals its card's semantic negative names already run in CI on every push: ci/check_release_gates_status.py --selftest refuses 12/12 malformed/false-closure controls, 15/15 evidence controls and 7/7 amputation controls, including 'unresolvable evidence commit', 'non-ancestor remote commit' and 'substituted executor (fixture green)'. Verified in the green run's own log. A duplicate authored court would add a second NAME for a refusal CI already exercises.
class_1_court_never_authored__SEVEN_OPEN.board_2: Recorded as a Board 2 watch-item: verifier-side court coverage for T73-T80 is owed with the receipt of the artifacts, not before.

class_2_path_is_stale__FIVE_COMPLETE.fact: THE COURT EXISTS AND EXECUTES; ONLY THE CARD'S PATH IS WRONG. Verified by direct inspection: T05-T08 declare android/mesh/src/test/java/io/godstone/mesh/readiness/ but live at .../mesh/crypto/ (ReadinessT05Test.kt .. ReadinessT08Test.kt, all present). T61 declares ios/Godstone/Tests/GodstoneLLMTests/ReadinessT61Tests.swift, a directory that does not exist; the court is ios/Godstone/Tests/GodstoneCoreTests/ReadinessT61Tests.swift, digest-pinned in ios/Packages/GodstoneFoundation/SOURCE_MANIFEST.json:117.
class_2_path_is_stale__FIVE_COMPLETE.evidence_they_are_LIVE_witnesses_not_orp: T05's record names two `killed_by` arms which are real functions in ReadinessT05Test.kt (:73 testForgedInPolicyNonce_AuthenticationFailureCommitsNothing, :92 testFailedAuthenticationConsumesNothing_RetransmissionRecovers), and they are what KILLED its commit-before-AEAD mutant.
class_2_path_is_stale__FIVE_COMPLETE.THE_ASYMMETRIC_RISK_THIS_CLASS_CARRIES: These five are COMPLETE and DISCHARGED. Reading the unresolved path as a missing witness would reopen finished tasks as internal work -- which would break the 72/12/0 tally and manufacture work that does not exist, the same overclaim direction this programme punishes. THEY MUST NOT BE REOPENED. This is stale metadata on discharged tasks, not a gap.

catalogue_path_gap.T76_is_the_MIXED_CASE: T76 is NOT purely external and is named as such rather than smoothed over: its preparatory half -- nonsecret signing metadata, entitlement/permission reasons, dependency licences, privacy description, store-policy checklist, support/recovery guide -- is internally preparable, and docs/SIGNING_METADATA.md, docs/PRIVACY.md, docs/DEPENDENCY_LICENSES.md, docs/STORE_POLICY_CHECKLIST.md and docs/SUPPORT_RECOVERY.md are all absent. Only the SIGNING POLICY AND CREDENTIALS are the external half. T76 therefore has arguable internal remainder and is listed as such, like the Robolectric cache item.
catalogue_path_gap.correction_note: An earlier draft of BOARD1_CLOSURE.md argued the twelve are external BECAUSE their paths are absent. That is inverted and was removed: absence of a file is never proof of an external blocker. The operative authority is `python3 tools/readiness/blockers.py --check` -> VERDICT: PASS, the repository's own court on exactly this question, which requires every blocked task to name an approving human role, a recheck trigger, a required artifact schema and verification commands, and which refuses the moment internal work is reclassified as external. The named blockers are receipt EVENTS a human performs (T76: 'receipt of the signing policy and credentials'; T78: 'receipt of the approved native model artifacts').
